question: Who is the outlier, and what do I coach?
method: A store is a call when it is off its own pace and off the pack, after weather. The rank uses a robust score underneath. The screen shows dollars and percent, not that score.

stores.name: Northgate
stores.title: The deals, not the door
stores.say: Margin after financing cost broke versus this store’s habit. Discount rate on the file is unusable, so coach the tickets you can read.
try: Review Saturday’s written tickets for unauthorized discount
Care-plan attach on the mattress sit, before the customer stands up
Financing cost is in the margin — a longer term is not a free close
stores.why: Margin 34.1% versus 42.5% after financing cost. Margin dollars $10.7k versus $23.5k. New England coast: 1.0 in this week versus 0.3 in on the comparable days last year, high 76° versus 74°.
stores.wx_line: New England coast: 1.0 in this week versus 0.3 in on the comparable days last year, high 76° versus 74°.

learning.note: A flag counts as recovered if the next week’s weather-adjusted gap is −12% or better — back inside the pack, not merely less bad. Weather is simulated for the climate, not observed.
